svg.title: Nacre oil production and refining — petroleum network and electricity dependency
svg.desc: Ten countries are grouped by production, refining, and consumption roles. Directional links show offshore and onshore crude supply, delivery of refined diesel, and an associated natural gas feed to a generator.
